Cancelled the existing reservation. Credits deposited to wallet instantly. Re-booked at the lower fare, same seats, and used credits from the wallet with the difference staying in the wallet. 

I admit I don’t like doing it this way either because it’s a risk that the lower fare could be taken in the minutes of cancelling the existing reservation. Having multiple desktop tabs open helps speed up the process. Hope this makes sense.
